note: Draft register for Spec 060 (design D-23, PR #195 packet), opened 2026-10-21 under the owner-approved runnable-experiments campaign of the same date (member 17) and the portfolio triage of the same date, which recorded the mandatory drafting correction carried in F060-C05. Conventions as in Specs 032-042: requirement claims carry no falsification test where a gate or inspection is the operative check; boundaries carry the conditions under which each claim holds; evidence items carry observed_at from this draft because the cited facts were verified first-hand at drafting. The AEE lifecycle hooks have NOT run on this register; they are the freeze gate (tasks L4), and any recovery round they force changes claim text before any freeze digest is computed. ASM- ids name the assumptions each claim stands on: ASM-PHASE137-RECORD (Phase-137's recorded populations, tables, and layer-input hashes are the record of the two layers), ASM-PHASE384-RECORD (Phase-384 v2's recorded intervals are the record of the margin adjudication), ASM-PHASE384-ESTIMATOR (the v2 estimator as pinned is the estimator of record; its v1 predecessor's interval adjudication is INVALID and is never used), ASM-SPEC034-RECORD (Spec 034's ATTRIBUTED TO COMPOSITION verdict and its Mohenjo-daro-seals slice description are the finished D-20 record), ASM-LAYERS-AS-HELD (the two layers are held files whose pins are the Phase-137 record's recorded hashes), ASM-TYPE-AS-RECORDED (object type is each layer's recorded value; the Holdat layer carries no type field and its type is the constant SEAL), ASM-GATES-BEFORE-OUTCOME (integrity, reproduction, and census precede any outcome quantity), ASM-DESCRIPTION-NOT-CONTROL (a described covariate is not a controlled one), ASM-APPEND-ONLY (outcomes append; frozen records are never edited), ASM-NO-VERDICT-MOVES (by the design's own terms, no verdict moves under this design). FREEZE RECOVERY (2026-10-21): normalised to engine evidence values at 0.6-draft (kind observed, source_quality artifact; refs, source_ids, directions, descriptions, and observed_at values unchanged - the draft's free-form labels are not engine values and the aee 1.5.3 loader refuses them, round 0 at the freeze); freeze rulings DD-060-11 to DD-060-15 were carried into the boundaries of F060-C07, C09, C10, C11, and C13 before the hooks ran. At 0.7-draft the 15 irreducibility-challenged claim texts were restated as single head propositions with carried clauses moved into boundaries verbatim-in-substance (propositions, falsifiers, and verdict rules unchanged), and every multi-item claim's evidence gained mutual independent_of declarations naming the claim's other evidence source_ids - the within-claim pairs are distinct records (the Phase-137 results, the Phase-384 results and machinery, the design packet, the Spec 034 outcome), and the declarations state that fact. Final restatement within 0.7-draft: F060-C04, C10, and C14 heads were restated singly (C04's condition, C10's floors, and C14's no-pooling rule carried into their boundaries), clearing the last negation-conflict, irreducibility, and counterexample records. A further final restatement of F060-C12's head (assigned by the mapping of spec section 5.2 alone, its three-word mapping carried into its boundary) cleared the last negation-conflict record (C04/C12).

claims.text: Each layer's site effect is computed inside its own sign numbering.
claims.boundary: The layers number signs in different systems (the Holdat layer's native signs; the ICIT layer's three-digit codes). A crosswalk or mapping would import Phase-125's disagreement into the test that is supposed to locate it; sign treatment therefore remains a named, unseparated candidate carrier of any COMPOSITION DOES NOT outcome, exactly as the design's confounder list leaves it. Carried from the draft text: each layer's site effect is computed inside its own sign numbering, and the only cross-layer operation is the comparison of the two governing intervals. Carried rule: the two layers' signs are never pooled, mapped, or harmonised under Spec 060, and the only cross-layer operation is the comparison of the two governing intervals.
alternatives: harmonising sign identities across layers before computing effects (refused: it would decide by construction the question the falsifier asks)
falsification_tests: inspection of the execution's code path and results: any cross-layer sign mapping, pooled table, or harmonised column set falsifies compliance and voids the arm-2 outcome
